selection_rule: All six fixed real validation IDs; one metadata-selected synthetic ID per 18 evaluation-v2 families to cover annotation labels and clean sources. Remove exact/token/renamed/near>=0.85 against BOTH SFT optimizer and internal validation and other selected sources. Never replace failed IDs post-inference. Families disjoint between development and validation. Assign cyclic L1,L2,L3 by within-partition index; final synthetic clean source per partition gets L4. Keep original Level/annotation separately.
annotation_version: original prepared real + sealed evaluation-v2 annotation; independent source review overlay separately
selection_gate: Joint source-backed taxonomy and independent feedback improvement; no increased serious Level violations; full completion/schema; unresolved material disputes cannot establish a winner. Prior research exposure limits validation independence.
